defs.def: to sell and send goods to another country 出口；输出

ex.s: “The ability to design, build and export green technologies for producing clean water, clean air and healthy and abundant food is going to be the currency of power in the new century.”
ex.t: “设计、制造并向其他国家出口用于生产清洁水、清洁空气以及健康丰足食物的绿色技术的能力，将成为新世纪里实力的象征。”

ex.s: In the 1940s, the Americans and the British stationed in New Zealand during the war discovered this amazing fruit, and soon after that, the kiwi fruit began to be exported to the UK and later to the US.
ex.t: 20 世纪 40 年代，战争期间驻扎在新西兰的美国人和英国人发现了这种神奇的水果，此后不久，猕猴桃便开始出口到英国，后来又出口到美国。

ex.s: Thanks to this ancient library, we now know that goods arrived in Dunhuang from as far away as North-east Europe, and that goods were also exported from Dunhuang across Asia and Europe.
ex.t: 多亏了这座古老的书库，我们现在知道，有来自远至东北欧的商品运到了敦煌，同时也有商品从敦煌出口到亚洲和欧洲各地。

ex.s: The scrolls are so detailed that they describe the vast range of goods that were imported and exported from Dunhuang, such as ceramics, medicine, perfumes and fruit, to name just a few.
ex.t: 这些卷轴极其详细，描述了从敦煌进出口的琳琅满目的商品，例如陶瓷、药品、香水和水果，不胜枚举。

ex.s: Trading ships bringing imports to the city or carrying exports overseas, along with golden pleasure boats for the rich, were crowded together in the glassy water of the port.
ex.t: 运入城市的货船和载着出口物资出海的商船，以及富人们乘坐的金色游船，都拥挤地停泊在港口如镜的水面上。

defs.def: to introduce an idea or activity to another country or area 传播，输出（思想或活动）
to send data to another program, changing its form so that the other program can read it 输出；移出；调出
the selling and transporting of goods to another country 出口；输出

ex.s: I have learnt so many new skills and have already prepared a business plan for setting up my own export company!
ex.t: 我已经学到了很多新技能，并且已经为创办自己的出口公司准备好了商业计划书！

defs.def: a product that is sold to another country 出口产品；输出品
